content:
Context: 5. Final payment of accumulations in PF

Issuance of Annual Statement.Form 49, which includes details of missing credit/ to the subscribers latest by the 31st of July every year.  
The Annual Statement of GPF in debit should be despatched - GID (7), Rule 39.  
Government dues not recoverable.Amount due to the Government or amount misappropriated by the Government servant is not recoverable from the PF final payment to the subscriber.
